verdict.rationale: PTO policy setup is a fair question for a small-business payroll and HR product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions PTO policies, accrual rules, time-off approvals, or time off flowing automatically into payroll. The only nearby items are importing timesheet hours and connecting outside time-tracking tools, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
